judged_text: The RSS/ATOM feed polling subsystem (new gems, scheduled job, three site settings, an admin 'Embedding' settings tab) is a whole second feature that goes beyond 'embed URL handling and validation', and it is wired into the embed retrieve path (TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve calls Jobs::PollFeed synchronously). A user hitting /embed/best for an un-imported page triggers a full feed download and synchronous import of every feed item inside their background job, coupling the embed endpoint's latency and failure modes to feed health; if this feature is not in the stated requirements it should be split out.

adjudication.rationale: Diff adds a full feed polling/import feature (Gemfile adds `simple-rss`/`ruby-readability`; new scheduled job `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`; new site settings `embeddable_host`, `feed_polling_enabled`, `feed_polling_url`, `embed_by_username` in `config/site_settings.yml`; locale adds an "Embedding" settings section). It is also wired into the embed retrieval path: `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, which synchronously downloads/parses the feed (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) and iterates all items importing them (`TopicEmbed.import(...)`) before falling back to HTTP fetch. While this happens in the background job (`Jobs::RetrieveTopic` enqueued from `EmbedController#best`), the coupling of embed retrieval to feed health/size and synchronous execution is a concrete scope/architecture concern grounded in the diff rather than a direct correctness defect.
